app.title: Nexumia
app.select_game: Select a game to start playing with your friends.
app.install_pwa_desc: Install LocalGameGalaxy on your smartphone or desktop for a full-screen experience without the browser search bar.
app.install_pwa_hub_banner: Install the app on your smartphone for a native, full-screen gaming experience without the browser address bar!
app.ios_install_step1: 1. Tap the Share button in Safari (at the bottom or top of your screen).
app.ios_install_step2: 2. Scroll down and tap 'Add to Home Screen'.
app.ios_install_step3: 3. Tap 'Add' in the top right corner. The app will open in fullscreen mode without the address bar!

party_room.title: Party room
party_room.desc: One room for the whole evening: everyone joins with their own phone by QR code, the TV shows the game.

darts.title: Dart Checker
darts.description: Track your score in 301, 501 or Count Up games.

wordle.title: Wordle
wordle.description: Guess the hidden 5-letter word in 6 attempts. Play the daily challenge or duel friends.

sudoku.title: Sudoku
sudoku.description: Classic 9x9 number puzzle with 4 difficulty levels, pencil notes, and best times.

werewolf.title: Werewolf
werewolf.description: A game of deception and deduction.

imposter.title: Imposter
imposter.description: Find the imposter before they blend in!

qwixx.title: Qwixx
qwixx.description: Tactical dice-rolling score sheet game. Cross numbers, lock rows, and maximize your score!

guessart.title: GuessArt
guessart.description: Creative drawing & guessing party game! Pick words, draw on canvas, and let your friends guess your artwork.

storyteller.title: Storyteller
storyteller.description: Collaborative story writing game! Write stories turn by turn with modular modifiers like Blind Mode, Time Attack, and Word Roulette.

garticphone.title: Gartic Phone
garticphone.description: The hilarious pass-the-message drawing game! Write sentence ➔ Draw ➔ Guess ➔ Draw ➔ Animated Album Show!

party.title: Party Mode
party.description: Unified multiplayer lobby for synchronized party games: Gartic Phone & more!

melodiq.title: Melodiq
melodiq.description: Challenge your friends in this ultimate Karaoke showdown! Sing to the beat and hit the right notes.

melodiq_notes.title: Melodiq Notes
melodiq_notes.description: Band stage for up to 4 players: keys, guitar, bass, drums and vocals from sheet music, with learn, practice and perform modes. Play via MIDI, touch or microphone, phones join as pults.

kniffel.title: Yahtzee
kniffel.description: The classic dice game. Score points by cleverly combining 5 dice.

knister.title: Knister
knister.description: The popular 5x5 Dice Bingo! Form pairs, straights, and full houses on your grid.

cards.title: Card game scores
cards.description: Digital companion for tabletop card games: Life tracking (Schwimmen) and trick predictor (Oh Hell).

tabletop.title: Game Table
tabletop.description: Your own and imported games, the free table and every card, board and dice game in one place.
tabletop.dropzone_title: Drop game file or folder here
tabletop.standard_cards_desc: Mau-Mau, Skat, Poker or Rummy with a shared table and smartphone controller hands.
tabletop.liars_dice_desc: Bluffing dice game with 3D dice and hidden cups on each phone.
tabletop.checkers_desc: Classic board game on an 8x8 checkerboard.
tabletop.install_starter_pack_desc: Instantly installs Standard Card Deck, Checkers, and Liar's Dice into your library.
tabletop.mode_shared_device_hint: Pass it around – hands stay hidden when switching.
tabletop.mode_own_devices_hint: Open a session, players join with a QR code or link.

schwimmen.title: Schwimmen (Thirty-One)
schwimmen.desc: Collect 31, knock, three lives – for 2 to 9 players.

durak.title: Durak
durak.desc: Attack, beat, throw in – whoever is left with cards is the durak. 2 to 6 players.

arschloch.title: President (Arschloch)
arschloch.desc: Get rid of your cards and become president. 3 to 8 players.

skat.title: Skat
skat.desc: Bid, discard, take 61 points – for exactly 3 players.

maumau.title: Mau-Mau
maumau.desc: Match suit or rank, 7 draws two, 8 skips, jack wishes a suit – for 2 to 5 players.

schwarzer-peter.title: Schwarzer Peter
schwarzer-peter.desc: Discard pairs and draw blind in turn – whoever holds the jack of spades at the end loses. For 2 to 6 players.

golf.title: Golf
golf.desc: Six cards in a grid, pairs in a column count zero. Nine holes, fewest points win – for 2 to 6 players.

cabo.title: Cabo
cabo.desc: Four face-down cards: remember, swap, peek – call Cabo when you have the fewest points. For 2 to 6 players.

drawpot.title: Draw Pot
drawpot.description: Draw names, teams or secret santa partners via a shared link

lobby.playersSetupDesc: Add at least {{min}} players. Play flexibly on one device or with separate invite links.

passAndPlay.playersHint: The device is passed around. Applying starts a new game.

settings.title: Settings
settings.general_desc: Language, appearance, feedback, and GitHub integration.
settings.melodiq_notes_desc: Configure sounds, soundfonts, and custom audio samples for Melodiq Notes.
settings.server_desc: Central WebRTC signaling for all party games and modular companion servers (e.g. MelodiQ Audio AI).

settings.companion_plugins_desc: Optional server containers for game-specific features like AI audio, asset streaming, and playlists.
settings.companion_melodiq_desc: Audio separation (UVR MDX-Net), Whisper AI text extraction, song streaming, and USDB integration.
settings.companion_tabletop_desc: Asset caching, TTS/PCIO deck conversion, and physics sync for tabletop simulations.
settings.companion_tabletop_planned_desc: This interface will locally host and stream large 3D assets, custom card decks, and synchronized tabletop states in the future.
settings.compose_generator_desc: Pick services, ports and folders – the docker-compose.yml below updates right away. The token above is used.
settings.companion_tabletop_error_load: Could not load the tabletop server
settings.companion_tabletop_tunnel_inactive: No tunnel — only available on local network
settings.appearance_desc: Colour mode of the app. TV mode is always dark.
settings.feedback_desc: Found a bug or have a suggestion? Submit it here to create a GitHub issue via your configured connection.
settings.feedback_no_config: No GitHub connection configured. Please set up a GitHub Token in General Settings or connect a Nexumia Server.
settings.github_missing_desc: To submit feedback or bug reports as GitHub issues, please configure a Personal Access Token (PAT) in Settings first.
settings.pat_hint_feedback: Please configure a GitHub Personal Access Token (PAT) below to submit feedback or bug reports as issues.
settings.pwa_status_standalone: The app is currently running in full-screen standalone mode (PWA).
settings.pwa_status_browser: The app is running inside a web browser. Install the PWA to remove browser toolbars and search bars for a native mobile experience.
settings.notifications_relay_desc: Web Push & ntfy.sh topic sync for global multiplayer notifications
settings.notifications_desc: Push notifications let you know when it's your turn in a game (e.g. GuessArt) – even when the app is closed.
settings.relay_desc: URL of your Cloudflare Worker or Nexumia Server that forwards push notifications to other players. Automatically embedded in shared game links.
settings.relay_no_vapid: Server reachable, but no VAPID key configured.

settings.relay_worker_guide_desc: The Cloudflare Worker runs 24/7 for free in the cloud and automatically generates cryptographic keys on first run (Zero-Config).

settings.relay_manual_title: Alternative: Manual CLI deployment in terminal:

settings.ntfy_test_body: 🎉 Test successful! 100% Google-free notifications are working.
settings.ntfy_test_error: Failed to send to ntfy. Check server URL.
settings.ntfy_open_topic: Open / subscribe personal topic in ntfy
settings.ntfy_topic_helper: Unique, unguessable topic for this device. All your games will automatically send turns to this topic.
settings.ntfy_badge_desc: Receive pushes without Google Play Services directly in your ntfy app.
settings.notify_choice_title: How would you like to be notified?
settings.notify_choice_hint: You'll know when it's your turn, even when the app is closed.
settings.notify_device_desc: Uses your device's own notifications (Apple, Google or your browser). Your device will ask for permission next.
settings.notify_device_blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser's site settings and come back.
settings.notify_ntfy_desc: Works without Apple or Google services: install the free ntfy app and subscribe to your personal topic.

settings.server_setup_desc: Everything in one place: server app for Windows, macOS and Linux, Docker Compose with the games you want, Cloudflare or a terminal one-liner.

server.title: Nexumia Server Connection
server.desc: Connect to a Nexumia Server to stream your Melodiq karaoke song library, download tracks, and use AI vocal separation. Party games (GuessArt, Gartic Phone, Werewolf, Qwixx) run serverless and do not require this server.
server.conn_failed: Connection Failed. Check URL or Network.

setup.title: Automatic Server Setup
setup.subtitle: Choose how to start your companion server (Melodiq, Notes, Tabletop) – the token below applies to every option.
setup.token_saved_hint: This token is automatically saved in your app and embedded into generated configurations.
setup.step_1_desc: Download the server archive for your OS and extract it. The config.json is optional: without it the server creates its own token and pairs the app via a one-time link.
setup.step_3_desc: On first start the server opens this app with a one-time pairing link; confirm it and URL and key are saved. Later starts print the link in the console. With the downloaded config.json the app connects to localhost:3000 directly.

cloudflare.title: Free 24/7 Cloud Server
cloudflare.desc: Host your own relay server for free on Cloudflare Workers. Perfect for remote games with friends without keeping a PC running.
cloudflare.cli_title: Or deploy via Wrangler CLI from the server/ directory:

terminal.desc: Run this 1-line command in your terminal to automatically download, configure, and start the server:

admin.desc: Create API keys for friends so they can connect to your server. Share a connection link or QR code.
admin.webapp_url_desc: The web application address that friends will open. Links and QR codes will point here and automatically configure the server.

admin.perm_tabletop_saves: Store save games on the server (Tabletop)
admin.perm_tabletop_delete: Delete saved games on the server (Tabletop)
admin.perm_desc: Permissions control what this key is allowed to do on your server.
admin.perm_readonly_desc: Read-Only Mode: Can search songs, stream audio/video, and sing, but cannot delete files or modify server settings.
admin.perm_manage_desc: Allows accessing the admin dashboard, changing music directories, and managing other API keys.
admin.perm_delete_desc: Allows permanently deleting song files from the hard drive.
admin.qr_desc: Scan this QR code to connect to the server as "{{name}}"
admin.error_update_failed: Failed to update API key permissions

pairing.title: Pair with Nexumia server
pairing.desc: This link connects the app to the server at {{url}}. Continue only if you just started this server yourself.
pairing.paired: Connected. Server URL and API key are saved on this device.
pairing.invalid: This pairing link is invalid, expired or already used. Restart the server for a new link.
pairing.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
pairing.unreachable: The server at {{url}} cannot be reached. Make sure it is running.
pairing.https_hint: If it still fails, open the server URL once in a new tab (accept the certificate warning if it uses a self-signed certificate), then try again.
pairing.mixed_content: This https page cannot reach an http server on your network (mixed content). Use the server's https link (Cloudflare tunnel) or open the app via http.

connection.click_to_copy: Click to copy URL to send manually

signaling.title: Signaling Servers (Trackers)

stun.title: STUN servers (this device)
stun.invalid_url: Enter a URL like stun:host:port or stuns:host:port.
stun.duplicate_url: This STUN server is already in the list.
stun.no_servers_warning: No STUN server enabled. Phones can then only connect on the same network.

turn.title: TURN relay (optional, this device)
turn.invalid_url: Enter a URL like turn:host:3478 or turns:host:5349.
turn.hint: Off by default. A TURN server relays the (encrypted) connection when a phone cannot reach this device directly, e.g. on mobile data. Use a server you run or trust; it sees IP addresses, not content.

github.desc: Connect directly to GitHub for feedback and content publishing. Create a Personal Access Token (PAT) with "repo" scope on github.com/settings/tokens.
